thesis: The podcast discusses the evolution of media from traditional advertising to a landscape dominated by influencer-created content, which major platforms like Facebook and Instagram now view as the future. It highlights how early influencer marketing leveraged new channels to build significant businesses, while traditional media companies are realizing that digital platforms are their primary competitors.
